description: §14.8.9 S441 round 5 (F3) — an output column computed IN SQL from a protected column (`lower(passwordHash) AS x`) is the column's value re-encoded by the database. The row is tagged strip-all (its output keys are not statically reliable) and the client receives an empty object.
rationale: MEASURED before the fix, also on main (S441 round-4 review, F3): expression columns — `||`, lower/hex/CAST/substr/coalesce/json_object/group_concat, `pin + 0`, quoted / bracketed / table-qualified spellings, scalar subqueries — carried NO descriptor and the route served the value.
